description: NaOH crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaOH sheets oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to three H and five O atoms. There is one shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.47 Å) Na-H bond lengths. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent H and three O atoms. Both Na-H bond lengths are 2.17 Å. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and one longer (2.43 Å) Na-O bond length. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to five Na and one H atom.
